page.overview:
What is Ilcae?

Ilcae was a plane mentioned in the book The Cursed Land. It was the plane that Malvos wanted to escape to.

Ilcae had a Infinite Consortium safehouse set up by Baltrice.

It was conquered and compleated by New Phyrexia's Machine Legion.
